facts.fact: Resolução 72/2026 (approved in Council of Ministers 6 May 2026, BO 54 of 7 May 2026) does not approve a strategy: it takes stock of existing instruments and 'establishes the bases' for developing an Agenda Digital de Cabo Verde 2035, whose definition is a process still to be carried out.
The Resolution sets the vision of the Agenda Digital de Cabo Verde 2035 as a Digital Nation by 2035, structured in eight axes (annex).
On 6 May 2026 the Council of Ministers approved Resolução 72/2026, in force the day after publication on 7 May, setting the bases and eight axes for preparing the Agenda Digital 2035.
The Resolution lists the Estratégia de Economia Digital (EEDCV) 2025-2030 as 'aprovada em setembro de 2024', its focus being competitiveness, innovation and the digital economy.
